double_hit_definition: second transforming alteration; aggregate double-hit population
notes: Reference and sensitivity values are scenario assumptions, not measured progenitor parameters.
s_D is calculated as additional_rare_clone_growth_per_day divided by b; b*s_D is an approximate rare-clone growth scale, not an exact net growth rate in a mixed population.
Baseline D must not exceed total founder-marked burden and must be below 1001 for an initially event-free analysis.
Absence from tMN_VAF does not establish clinical event-free follow-up.
